title: CPAP Therapy Usage Consistency
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cpap:session
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(usage_hours>=4)) as successful by _time mask_type
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for CPAP therapy nights by mask type.
value: A 4-hour consistency rate is a practical way to see whether the therapy routine is holding.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for CPAP therapy nights events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for CPAP therapy nights by mask type.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how often CPAP therapy nights works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
